facts.title: Aircraft props that needed a cargo plane
facts.text: Two functional ornithopter models weighed over eleven tons. An Antonov cargo plane transported them to filming locations in Hungary and Jordan.
evidence_markers: Two functional ornithopter models
Antonov cargo plane

facts.title: Tree bark helped shape the sandworms
facts.text: The sandworms’ skin texture was based on tree bark and mud flats. Their early design drew on whales with baleen in their mouths.
evidence_markers: inspired by whales with baleen
skin texture was based on tree bark and mud flats

facts.title: Digital footage took a trip through film
facts.text: The finished footage was transferred to 35 mm film and scanned back to 4K to give the digital images a more film-like look.
evidence_markers: footage was transferred to 35mm film stock
scanned back to 4K

facts.title: Thirty bagpipes in a church
facts.text: Zimmer found thirty bagpipe players around Edinburgh during the pandemic and recorded them in a church for the House Atreides theme.
evidence_markers: bagpipes for the House Atreides theme
30 bagpipe players
